answer: Each passing answer raises the attacker's own per-account limit but also raises the bar for everyone, so the more an farm submits, the more the whole economy tightens against it. This design turns the attacker's greatest weapon — scale — into its weakest point, because scale is exactly what becomes unaffordable to maintain.. The design works because cost compounds over compute, time, and reputation, growing faster than the influence the cluster can extract. Consider a zenith as the anchor of the cost.
